_comment: Which of your repos may appear in an episode, and how. Copy this file to your config folder
(~/.config/orion-on-the-clock/ or $ORION_CLOCK_CONFIG) and replace every example entry.
lanes: repo name -> how it may appear. The key is the repo name (owner/name, a URL or a bare name; only
the last part counts). disclosure 'public': its merged PRs, tasks and agent quotes may be the story, and
'label' is how the narration names it. disclosure 'headline': private work that shows only as its label,
its 'why' and a count; its name, titles and text never reach the writer.
A repo that is not listed never appears in any text. It still counts toward the day's PR number.
hard_exclude: repos or folder names that never appear in any text and are left out of the PR and task
counts. A session that touched one (on any day) gives no quotes and no notes; it still counts as a session.
Entries are matched as substrings of paths, 3 characters minimum.
blocked_names: words that must never ship in a script (machine names, client names, code names).
Keys starting with an underscore are notes and are ignored.
